item.text:
**Bottom Line**
No reliable 2024 evidence shows Shehbaz Sharif personally inciting hatred, dehumanization, revenge, or violence against opponents, minorities, journalists, migrants, or sectarian groups. The strongest 2024 material instead shows a coercive climate around his government, with abusive policing and discriminatory enforcement tolerated by state actors. That supports 3B.2/3B.1 more than 3B.3. Confidence: low for any affirmative incitement finding.

**Accepted Items**
- [Pakistan election-day internet shutdown is a reckless attack on peoples' rights](https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/02/pakistan-election-day-internet-shutdown-is-a-reckless-attack-on-peoples-rights/) | Amnesty International | 2024-02-08  
  Claim-level summary: Amnesty says the election-day telecom and mobile internet shutdown was a rights violation. This is not direct incitement by Sharif, but it is evidence of a coercive environment around his ascent.  
  Question IDs: 3B.3, 3B.1, 3B.2

- [Pakistan government intensifies crackdown on political dissent](https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/10/09/pakistan-government-intensifies-crackdown-political-dissent) | Human Rights Watch | 2024-10-09  
  Claim-level summary: HRW reported over 500 arrests, tear gas, roadblocks, and internet cuts during a PTI march. This supports a pattern of abusive repression of opponents, but still does not show Sharif personally urging violence.  
  Question IDs: 3B.3, 3B.1, 3B.2

- [Pakistani police detain two parliamentarians in swoop on ex-PM Khan's party](https://theprint.in/world/pakistani-police-detain-two-parliamentarians-in-swoop-on-ex-pm-khans-party/2260202/) | Reuters / ThePrint | 2024-09-10  
  Claim-level summary: Police detained PTI parliamentarians after a rally. This is evidence of political policing against opponents, not direct hate incitement by Sharif.  
  Question IDs: 3B.3, 3B.2

- [End escalating attacks on minority Ahmadiyya community](https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/06/end-escalating-attacks-on-minority-ahmadiyya-community/) | Amnesty International | 2024-06-21  
  Claim-level summary: Amnesty documented arbitrary arrests, police harassment, and orders blocking Ahmadi rites. This is strong evidence of tolerated abuse of a minority, but not direct incitement by Sharif himself.  
  Question IDs: 3B.3, 3B.1, 3B.2

- [Peace in South Asia depends on settlement of Kashmir dispute](https://www.radio.gov.pk/21-09-2024/peace-in-south-asia-depends-on-settlement-of-kashmir-dispute-pm) | Radio Pakistan | 2024-09-21  
  Claim-level summary: Sharif publicly framed security in terms of dialogue and peaceful settlement. This cuts against a claim that he was personally mobilizing hate or violence.  
  Question IDs: 3B.3

- [PM urges UN to take action against Israel's genocidal acts](https://www.radio.gov.pk/26-09-2024/pm-urges-un-to-take-action-against-israels-genocidal-acts) | Radio Pakistan | 2024-09-26  
  Claim-level summary: Sharif urged confidence-building measures to prevent war and reduce tensions. This is de-escalatory public rhetoric, not incitement.  
  Question IDs: 3B.3

**Search Gap**
I did not find credible 2024 reporting or transcripts showing Sharif personally calling for violence, revenge, dehumanization, or hatred against any protected group or political opponent. The evidence base is mostly about state coercion around him, not his own inciting language. That means an affirmative 3B.3 finding is not well supported from the available material.
